result.summary: Found 1 major layout issue: restaurant card titles and delivery info are truncated in the Fastest near you carousel.

issues.description: In the Fastest near you section, restaurant names and delivery prices are clipped (e.g. Trattoria Piccol cut off, and delivery text truncated) even on fully visible cards, not only the last peeking item.
issues.suggestion: Allow card titles and meta text to wrap to two lines or shrink/truncate with ellipsis consistently so names and fees remain readable on all cards.
